assignmentHtml.task: Research Diary of 4 YouTube channel comprehensively. Find: (1) Stable channel ID and canonical URL. (2) Operator/creators - who runs Diary of 4? Family? (3) Channel creation date and earliest still-public upload. (4) Operating location and displayed country. (5) Languages. (6) Primary content category. (7) Content supply model. (8) Representative series. Provide direct source URLs.
assignmentHtml.context: Diary of 4 is #22/#23 with ~75B lifetime views per Communitrics snapshot dated September 2, 2026. Need verifiable facts with source links.
assignmentHtml.expected_output: A structured dossier for Diary of 4 with all requested fields, each with source URLs.

answerHtml:
Diary of 4 – Channel Dossier

(1) Stable Channel ID & Canonical URL

  • Channel ID: UCT6zcE-d5Rlc2xto-1lNjgA
  • Handle/canonical URL: https://www.youtube.com/@Diaryof4
  • Full channel URL: https://www.youtube.com/channel/UCT6zcE-d5Rlc2xto-1lNjgA

(2) Operator/Creators
Run by the Santiago family — parents Francis and Kristel (Filipino immigrants), daughters Ember (born 2017) and son Keegan (born March 2022). The family self-produces content. In June 2025, Toronto's Little Engine Moving Pictures signed an exclusive deal to co-develop and produce new content.

(3) Channel Creation Date & Earliest Still-Public Upload

  • Channel account created: October 20, 2008 (confirmed by Social Blade, Famous Birthdays, VidIQ)
  • Actual video uploads began: Spring 2019, under the name "What Ember Loves" (per SaltWire/March 2024 article)
  • Rebranded to "Diary of 4": August 2022 (per SaltWire)
  • The earliest still-public upload cannot be precisely dated from available sources; the channel was inactive from 2008 until spring 2019. Direct YouTube access is blocked by CAPTCHA, preventing verification of the oldest public video.

(4) Operating Location & Displayed Country

  • Based in Summerside, Prince Edward Island (PEI), Canada
  • Country displayed: Canada (🇨🇦 per Vidualyze, Communitrics, channel banner)
  • Family origin: Manila, Philippines

(5) Languages

  • Primary language: English (per Wikipedia's List of most-viewed YouTube channels)
  • Filipino/Tagalog implied by family origin

(6) Primary Content Category

  • Lifestyle (Vidualyze), People (Wikipedia), Family genre (Famous Birthdays)
  • Content mix: comedy pranks, pretend play, family skits, kids' learning/manners videos, heartwarming family moments

(7) Content Supply Model

  • Self-produced, original content created by the Santiago family (Francis and Kristel film approximately 4 short videos per day)
  • As of June 2025, expanded via exclusive production partnership with Little Engine Moving Pictures (Canada) to develop new formats including a live-action series, animated shorts, and a Roblox game
  • Not licensed or user-aggregated content; entirely family-made

(8) Representative Series

  • "Diary of 4 Live Game" — live-streamed gaming series (Parts 1–28+)
  • "Family Drama Skits | Diary of 4 Best Moments" — compilation playlist
  • "Diary of 4 Pranks" — prank compilation
  • "The Ultimate Family Prank Show" — long-form prank special
  • "Family Chaos Compilation" — compilation
  • Educational skits: "Good Manners for Kids," "Kids Learn…" series
  • "Diary of 4: Wild Adventures" — in-development live-action comedy series (Little Engine, budget $2.5M–$5M)

Key metrics (as of September 2026): ~26.6M subscribers, ~75B lifetime views, ~6.6K videos, ranked #22–23 globally by views (Communitrics snapshot Sept 2, 2026).
